areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Flood-control drainage ties to the sanitation aspect of the area; relevant indicators and viable targets, but limited direct beneficiaries and narrow coverage of the area give low impact; solution not innovative.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Specific objective on restoring natural microbasins with a solid-waste indicator and viable target, but limited magnitude yields restricted impact against the breadth of the area.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: General objective, component and indicators directly aligned; all resources go to flood-control works; direct beneficiaries limited but indirect benefits broad, moderate impact.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Relevant to urban stormwater management; solid-waste indicator is of minor relevance, and no evidence of broader efficient and rational water use.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: General objective unrelated to sport; no specific objectives, indicators or targets; small budget share and sports equipment at one site only, without engagement strategy.
